items.description: A new Android malware called DroidLock has emerged with capabilities to lock screens for ransom payments, erase data, access text messages, call logs, contacts, and audio data. [...]

items.title: React2Shell Exploitation Delivers Crypto Miners and New Malware Across Multiple Sectors
